reasons: The only MFN provision (p1099) runs in the Customer's favour — MSL (Vendor) commits to price its engineering to IBM (Customer) on a 'most favored customer' basis — which matches the rule's preferred position that Vendor-granted MFN is welcome and no MFN burden falls on Customer.
Consistent with a compliant finding, the redline is identical to the original text and no counterparty comment is proposed; deterministic checks are empty, confirming no edit was attempted.

Rationale is accurate and supported by the cited text, and correctly notes that no obligation on IBM to match or extend third-party terms was found in the pricing provisions, so the finding is properly retained as internal evidence rather than a negotiation issue.
